crossRefs.note: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service…
They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.
Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom…
The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who…
whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave; all of them slain, fallen…

translations.web: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.
translations.bsb: But you will be brought down to Sheol, to the lowest depths of the Pit.
translations.kjv: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
translations.asv: Yet thou shalt be brought down to Sheol, to the uttermost parts of the pit.
